entities.summary: Kathleen Margaret "Kathie" Satchwell is a retired judge and human rights advocate. She served on the Gauteng Division of the High Court in South Africa from 1996 and is recognised for her contributions to constitutional jurisprudence, gender equality, and the transformation of the South African judiciary. She is also known for her legal activism during the apartheid era and leadership of the Satchwell Commission in road accident compensation reform.
